input_contract: Rust harness contract payload describing bounded unsafe/auth paths.
output_contract: ovk.result.v1 with trace counterexamples (deterministic evaluator today)

guarantee.meaning_of_pass: Kani found no safety violation in bounded harness.

assumptions: Rust harness captures relevant unsafe paths.
limits: Bounded loops and memory model approximations.
failure_semantics: Unavailable Kani or incomplete harness maps to unknown; evaluator errors map to error.
unsupported_semantics: Native Kani execution is not implemented; bounded loops and memory model approximations only.
